sentence: SGLT2 inhibitors are tablets used for type 2 diabetes, heart failure and chronic kidney disease.
note: NHS dapagliflozin page lists the three uses; CUH leaflet: type 2 diabetes and/or kidney and heart protection.

sentence: They lower blood sugar by acting on the kidneys, as the NHS describes for dapagliflozin.
note: NHS: dapagliflozin makes the kidneys remove extra sugar in urine.

sentence: The NHS says dapagliflozin, a medicine of this type, makes the kidneys remove extra sugar in the urine, which lowers blood sugar.
Cambridge University Hospitals says the kidney and heart benefits of these medicines apply beyond people with diabetes.
note: CUH leaflet (search excerpt): benefits apply beyond people with diabetes.

sentence: Leeds Teaching Hospitals lists genital fungal infections such as thrush as a common side effect of these medicines

Leeds Teaching Hospitals says these medicines may cause acids called ketones to build up in the blood (diabetic ketoacidosis), with warning symptoms including stomach pain, feeling sick and vomiting, rapid breathing and dehydration, which need urgent medical help (a doctor or NHS 111 promptly, or 999 in an emergency)
note: Leeds leaflet via search summary; urgent-help route per site signposting rule.

sentence: NHS leaflets describe sick day rules, in which the medicine is stopped temporarily during illness such as infection, diarrhoea and vomiting or flu

Severe pain, tenderness, swelling or redness around the genitals or the area between them and the anus, with fever or feeling unwell, can be a rare infection called Fournier gangrene and needs emergency help (call 999)
note: NHS dapagliflozin page and NHS leaflet: rare, emergency treatment; symptoms. 999 per site rule.
